pre_registration_status: prospective for new runs; thresholds supplied after historical results were known, not a retrospective preregistration claim
input_accuracy_scale: fraction [0,1]; multiply paired differences by 100 to pp
allowed_treatment_differences: method-specific optimizer/BN scope for baseline comparisons
declared arm intervention only for RGA/DSR

summaries.replication: stored checkpoint sensitivity; upstream training seeds unknown
summaries.paired_difference: FedRAS minus comparator for same checkpoint
summaries.missing_pair: report missing provenance; no imputation, no unpaired substitution
summaries.interpretation: exploratory checkpoint-conditional intervals, no independent-training-seed or formal equivalence claim

order_range_provenance: user supplied historical sensitivity ranges; descriptive comparators, not statistical noise estimates or standard errors

required: paired CI excludes zero in the claimed direction
absolute mean paired gap exceeds endpoint historical order range
clean_revisit_claim_rule.otherwise: mean difference, not resolvable under this reporting rule; no highest/advantage or demonstrated trade-off claim

acceptance: 45 continual blocks with 10000 samples each; no truncation
15 DW blocks separately required only when arm requests DW
frozen Clean/Revisit state checks all true
effective runtime config and source hashes archived
never promote missing data or completed process to semantic claim acceptance
